summary: Alamos Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its first-quarter 2026 results. The filing includes a press release, management's discussion and analysis, and unaudited interim financial statements. It details quarterly production of 123,900 ounces, record revenues of $596.7 million, and free cash flow of $101.7 million. This is an earnings release, not a special-situation event. As a routine quarterly report, it does not trigger any special-situation classification.
